feature_intro.title: 📖 Feature Introduction
feature_intro.features:
• Support Excel/CSV file import for contacts
• Auto dial and play voice messages
• Support call recording (requires ROOT)
• Export call record statistics
• Support clipboard import for phone numbers
• Support multiple SIM card selection and dual-SIM alternation
• Auto check for updates and background download
• Accessibility service for dialing assistance

accessibility.title: ♿ Accessibility Mode
accessibility.disabled: ❌ Disabled: Tap to enable accessibility mode
accessibility.description: Accessibility mode assists auto dialing by monitoring window state to optimize dialing flow

auto_call.title: 📞 Auto Dial
auto_call.items:
• Support batch import contacts from Excel/CSV files
• Auto recognize account numbers and balance information
• Auto dial phone numbers in sequence
• Support pause, resume and stop operations

audio_playback.title: 🔊 Audio Playback
audio_playback.items:
• Auto play preset voice files during calls
• Support custom import of audio files
• Select voice messages for different scenarios (insufficient balance, power outage, etc.)
• Note: Non-ROOT devices may not allow the other party to hear

call_recording.title: 🎙️ Call Recording
call_recording.items:
• Auto record call content
• Save to local storage
• Note: Requires ROOT permission to work properly

sim_card.title: 💳 SIM Card Management
sim_card.items:
• Support selecting SIM card 1 or SIM card 2 for dialing
• Dual-SIM alternate mode, alternate between two cards
• Smart recognition of available SIM cards

statistics.title: 📊 Data Statistics
statistics.items:
• Real-time statistics of call count and success rate
• Support sorting by call count
• Support sorting by balance
• Export call records in CSV format

auto_update.title: 🔄 Auto Update
auto_update.items:
• Auto check for latest version on startup
• Download APK files in background
• Display download progress
• Auto trigger installation after download completes

accessibility.title: ♿ Accessibility Mode
accessibility.items:
• Assist auto dialing functionality
• Monitor window state to optimize dialing flow
• Users can enable or disable in settings at any time
• No personal data is collected or uploaded

function_limitation.title: ❗ Function Limitation Notice
function_limitation.warning: ⚠️ Due to Android system security restrictions, the following functions may be limited:
function_limitation.items:
• Call recording function may not work properly on non-ROOT devices
• Audio injection (letting the other party hear voice) may be blocked by the system
• Some Android versions strictly restrict app access to call audio channels

permission_notice.title: 📋 Permission Usage Notice
permission_notice.items:
• CALL_PHONE: For auto dialing function
• READ_PHONE_STATE: For monitoring call status and SIM card information
• RECORD_AUDIO: For call recording function (optional)
• READ_MEDIA_AUDIO: For reading and playing audio files
• INTERNET: For checking software updates
• REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES: For installing updated APK files
• BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE: For accessibility assistance

privacy_policy.title: 🔐 Privacy Protection
privacy_policy.items:
• This software will not collect, upload or share any personal information
• All data is stored only on local devices
• Contact information, call records and other data are fully controlled by users
• The software does not contain any advertisements or tracking code
• Accessibility service is only used for dialing assistance, no data is collected

data_privacy.title: 🛡️ Data Privacy Protection
data_privacy.items:
• All data is stored only on the local device
• No user data will be collected, uploaded or shared
• Call records, contacts and other information are fully controlled by users
• All data will be automatically cleared after uninstalling the app

user_responsibility.title: 👤 User Responsibility Statement
user_responsibility.items:
• Users must comply with local laws and regulations when using this software
• It is prohibited to use this software for harassment, fraud and other illegal activities
• If legal problems arise due to non-compliant use, users shall bear the responsibility themselves
• It is recommended to use this software only in legal and compliant scenarios
